integrity: All central general assertions are proved analytically; independent exact-rational and symbolic code checks finite examples. Exact non-identifiability example uses positive bounded nonstationary trajectories; independent audit not performed.
scientific_limitations: Complete noiseless abundances and instantaneous derivatives; known hard-triad polynomial support; genericity in unrestricted/open coefficient domains for any fixed positive initial condition, local observation horizon; no noise robustness or broad constraint-manifold genericity, and no assertion of priority certification.
title: Generic single-trajectory recovery and an exact hidden-interaction leaf in triadic ecological dynamics
